import json
import pdf_ops

FIELD_NAME = 'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY'
OLD_TEXT = 'It its first year'
START = 490
END = 507
REPLACEMENT = 'In its first year'

doc = pdf_ops.open("input.pdf")
field = pdf_ops.find_field(doc, FIELD_NAME)
value = field.value
if value[START:END] != OLD_TEXT:
    raise pdf_ops.TargetNotFoundError("the field value no longer contains the expected text at the given position")
new_value = value[:START] + REPLACEMENT + value[END:]
result = pdf_ops.update_form_field(doc, FIELD_NAME, new_value, min_scale=0.9)
pdf_ops.save(doc, "output.pdf")
print(json.dumps({"method": "form_field_update", "field": FIELD_NAME, "changed": [OLD_TEXT, REPLACEMENT],
                  "widgets": result["widgets"]}))
